name: rol-pagos-ecuador
description: Rol de pagos Ecuador 2026: API Express + aplicación Angular

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix backend start
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test -- --no-watch
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
